prose:
A Show HN author says they used ChatGPT while building Outpost Racer, a browser racing game styled after the original PlayStation era. The live landing page exposes play and settings links but supplies almost no explanatory text.

The source supports a small personal-project announcement and the author's account of assistance, not a measured claim about development speed or autonomous software creation. Gameplay, controls, performance and the division of work between the person and the model were not tested.
highlights: AI assistance is the creator's self-report
Landing page contains little readable documentation
Play and settings links are visible
Retro styling is an announced design goal
No gameplay review or productivity measurement follows
